about_the_game:
CoopScoop is a VR arcade-style game that revolves around managing a chicken farm. A chicken epidemic has broken out and you need to make sure all your chickens stay healthy and happy. Wash your chickens, cure the infected ones and quarantine the green chickens! Keep your chickens alive for as long as you can, because that’s how we do it chicken-farmer-style!

Features

  • 🐔 Chicken Farming:
    Experience the joys and challenges of running a chicken farm. Test your management abilities and decision-making in a high-stakes farming simulation.

  • 🌾 Epidemic Survival:
    A chicken virus is sweeping the country, and it's up to you to keep your flock healthy and happy. Wash, feed, and care for your chickens to prevent infection.


    Will you rise to the occasion and save your chickens from the epidemic? Get ready to embark on your CoopScoop journey today and show the world your farming prowess!

  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (64bit)

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: A chicken virus spreads rapidly across the country and some of your chickens have gotten sick! You need to wash them, feed them and take good care of them to maintain a stable farm. Can you manage all those chickens?
